_comment: IMM switching demonstration scenario for sub-project A. Target cruises at constant velocity for frames 0-40, then transitions to drag-coast for frames 40-80. Amplitude tuned to marginal SNR so probabilistic coast streaks occur; with --max-coast 15, those streaks survive long enough for the algorithm differences to manifest. Expected per-phase behavior: KF tracks CV phase, drifts in drag phase; EKF drifts in CV phase, tracks drag phase; IMM tracks both via mode-probability switching at frame ~40.
